title: Security Operations Manager
description:
Security Operations Manager – Security & Facility Management

**Location:** Gurgaon  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

About the Company

We are a leading Security & Facility Management Services provider committed to delivering high-quality security, housekeeping, technical, and facility management solutions across commercial, residential, industrial, healthcare, and corporate sectors. We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Operations Manager to lead field operations and ensure exceptional service delivery.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage day-to-day operations of security and facility management services across multiple client locations.
* Ensure deployment of security personnel, housekeeping staff, and other facility teams as per client requirements.
* Monitor service quality and compliance with company SOPs and client SLAs.
* Conduct regular site inspections, audits, and performance reviews.
* Maintain strong client relationships and promptly resolve operational issues and escalations.
* Coordinate recruitment, onboarding, deployment, and training of field personnel.
* Ensure statutory compliance, including labor laws, ESI, PF, wages, and company policies.
* Prepare operational reports, MIS, attendance, deployment records, and incident reports.
* Coordinate with HR, payroll, procurement, and administration departments for smooth operations.
* Manage workforce planning, scheduling, and emergency manpower requirements.
* Drive employee discipline, productivity, and customer satisfaction.
* Identify opportunities for operational improvements and cost optimization.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, or a related field.
* 5–10 years of experience in Security Services or Facility Management operations.
* Proven experience managing multiple client sites and large field teams.
* Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Good knowledge of labor laws, statutory compliance, and workforce management.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and MIS reporting.
* Ability to travel frequently to client locations.

Preferred Skills

* Excellent client relationship management.
* Team leadership and conflict resolution.
* Strong planning, coordination, and organizational skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet service delivery commitments.
* Experience with security operations, housekeeping, technical services, and facility maintenance.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary and performance incentives.
* Career growth opportunities.
* Professional and supportive work environment.
* Ongoing learning and development.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance

Work Location: In person
